success: First task-predicate success ends the trajectory; first-success step is saved episode length for successes, null otherwise. Derive success by115,250,300 inclusively from each same trajectory.
seed_pairing: Seeds0..29; reuse frozen v1 Can canonical simulator inputs and require identical restored full states/observations across all methods and conditions.
sampling_noise: Fresh noise per planning step from seed 1000003*episode_seed+step+7919; shared across generative methods and blackout conditions

training.split: Seeded 95%/5% episode split, shared within task; train-only observation statistics; native actions
training.cfm: train_flow_matching_recovery; skip_v2 width128; Gaussian OT path; prior_aug_prob0.5
training.ddim: train_diffusion_recovery; same architecture, data, updates, optimizer, EMA and prior augmentation; bounded x0 objective; DDIM10
training.bc: Reactive 256-wide two-hidden-layer ELU MLP; same training windows/query distribution, batch size and update count; real observations during training; EMA held-out first-action MSE selection
training.reuse: Evaluation only. Reuse all selected Can WM, CFM, DDIM, and BC checkpoints from completed matched_baselines_v1; no training or new checkpoint selection.

baseline_definitions.cfm4: RSSM posterior/prior beliefs; Euler4; replan each step; execute first of8 actions
baseline_definitions.ddim10: RSSM posterior/prior beliefs; bounded-x0 DDIM10; replan each step
baseline_definitions.open_loop: Same DDIM checkpoint, execute8-action chunks; zero-fill normalized observations during blackout and update RSSM posterior, with no prior-imputation branch
baseline_definitions.bc: Reactive BC; zero-fill every normalized observation coordinate during blackout; no recurrent state

metrics: Primary: successes/N at300 with Wilson95% CI
Secondary: successes by115 and250 from identical trajectories
Per-seed first-success times and exact paired starts
Agreement of115step prefixes with archived v1 records, reported without adaptive reruns
inference_limits: One training seed; seeds0..29 preserve our horizon comparison. This does not claim exact reproduction of the external reference using seeds1000..1029 and different checkpoints.
stopping: No success-based truncation of the grid or retraining of negative methods; engineering exceptions are fixed separately and incomplete episodes resumed; completed episode records are never overwritten

host_observation_calibration.physics_reference: Archived v1 restored full simulator states must remain exactly equal
host_observation_calibration.sensor_reference: Capture once on new host from unchanged canonical physical states; require two exactly repeating captures and exact equality across every method/condition. Retain v1 observation reference and audit deltas.
host_observation_calibration.rationale: First attempt stopped because cross-host derived quaternion differences were rejected, despite exact physical state restoration. No checkpoint, seed, horizon, action sampling, or success criterion changes.

runtime_backend: macOS CPU, Python3.10, Torch2.4, MuJoCo2.3.7; one Torch thread per worker, up to4 workers; all four methods on the same host.
